name: jd_jzt-mcp
description: 京准通 JD JZT (ads): me, list_campaigns, update_budget, pause_resume. Every tool maps to a documented e

platform_mcp_jd_jzt_app_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_JZT_APP_KEY
platform_mcp_jd_jzt_app_key.description: app_key of the JOS (京东宙斯) application approved for the 京准通 API permission package (https://opendoc.jd.com/ads_api/jzt/api/word/settle.html).

platform_mcp_jd_jzt_app_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_JZT_APP_SECRET
platform_mcp_jd_jzt_app_secret.description: appSecret of that application; never sent, used for the MD5 request signature.

platform_mcp_jd_jzt_access_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_JD_JZT_ACCESS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_jd_jzt_access_token.description: OAuth access_token of the 京准通 PIN that authorised the app (https://jos.jd.com/commondoc?listId=32); renew it through the JOS authorisation flow when it expires.

tools.name: me
tools.description: No profile call is documented for the 京准通 API; the probe lists one 搜索快车 campaign (jingdong.ads.dsp.rtb.kuaiche.campaign.list.v2, pageSize 1).

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: 查询普通计划列表 (jingdong.ads.dsp.rtb.kuaiche.campaign.list.v2): 京东搜索快车 campaigns (普通快车商品计划, 腰带店铺计划, 门店商品计划) with today's metrics (startDay = endDay = today, clickOrOrderDay 0, click caliber, gifts excluded). Each row is {item: {campaignId, campaignName, campaignType, status (1 暂停, 2 启动, 3 预算用完, 4 不在投放时间段), budget (a string, left in raw), cost, clicks, impressions, CTR, CPC, totalOrderSum, totalOrderROI, …}}. account_id and status are not sent (the access_token's PIN selects the account).

tools.name: update_budget
tools.description: 修改预算 (jingdong.ads.dsp.rtb.kuaiche.campaign.updatebudget.v2, data {id, dayBudget}) sets the daily budget in 元 of one 搜索快车 campaign. This spends money. The 京准通 result {code, success, msg} comes back inside a successful gateway response (success = false when it was rejected). currency is ignored (CNY).

tools.name: pause_resume
tools.description: 修改状态 (jingdong.ads.dsp.rtb.kuaiche.campaign.updatestatus.v2, data {ids: [campaign_id], operateType}) with pause → 1 (暂停) and resume → 2 (启动). success = false in the result means the platform rejected it. Resuming restarts spend.
